SWZ.note: Birth registration and ID cards described separately; no exchange between them stated.
No ID enrolment count or share; only 30,000 birth certificates issued.
Closing of the Tap registers newborns at health facilities but no ID number at birth is stated.
No operator or ownership detail given.
No register keyed on the ID number mentioned.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Home Affairs says national identity cards were introduced in 2005 under the Identification Order of 1998 and the systems were later automated.
